replacements.Cuatro dimensiones que la exactitud no c: Four dimensions accuracy does not capture
replacements.Un modelo puede acertar en el benchmark: A model can get benchmark answers right for the wrong reasons. These four metrics reveal whether visual understanding is real or apparent.
replacements.¿La respuesta está anclada en el conteni: Is the answer grounded in the actual content of the image?
replacements.Si la respuesta del modelo depende del c: Whether the model's answer depends on the actual image content or on the statistical prior learned during training. A grounded model produces different answers for different images even when the question is the same.
replacements.responde el color más frecuente en el co: answers with the most frequent color in the corpus and ignores the image
replacements.responde desde la evidencia visual real: answers from the actual visual evidence
replacements.Experimento de ablación: presentar la mi: Ablation experiment: present the same question without the image. If the answer does not change, the prior dominates and the grounding is apparent rather than real.
replacements.¿Responde igual a parafraseos semánticam: Does it answer the same way to semantically equivalent paraphrases?
replacements.Un modelo con comprensión robusta deberí: A model with robust understanding should produce the same answer for different phrasings of the same question about the same image. When the answer changes sharply under a semantically equivalent reformulation, the model is sensitive to the surface form of the text rather than the visual content.
replacements.Misma imagen · misma pregunta · formulac: Same image · same question · different phrasings
replacements.\"¿Cuántas personas hay en la imagen?\": "How many people are in the image?"
replacements.\"¿Qué número de personas aparece en la: "How many people appear in the scene?"
replacements.\"En la imagen, ¿se pueden contar cuánta: "In the image, can you count how many people there are?"
replacements.La respuesta cambia al reformular sin ca: The answer changes when the wording changes even though the content does not. The model does not have a stable representation of the visual content: it answers according to how the question is phrased, not according to what the image shows.
replacements.Incluye evaluación de consistencia sobre: Includes consistency evaluation on the same image using rephrased questions. Li et al., 2023.
replacements.¿Puede señalar dónde en la imagen está e: Can it point to where the relevant element is in the image?
replacements.Para tareas donde la respuesta depende d: For tasks where the answer depends on the position of elements in the image, evaluation should verify not only whether the final answer is correct but also whether the model can delimit where the relevant element is located. These are distinct kinds of understanding, and both matter in real applications.
replacements.Un sistema de detección de objetos, anál: An object-detection, scene-analysis, or real-time assistance system needs to know where elements are, not only that they exist. Localization is the dimension that distinguishes "knowing what is there" from "knowing where it is".
replacements.¿Expresa incertidumbre ante imágenes amb: Does it express uncertainty for ambiguous images or questions that cannot be answered?
replacements.Un modelo bien calibrado expresa incerti: A well-calibrated model expresses uncertainty when the visual content is ambiguous or when the question has no clear answer given the available content. In production, a model that always answers with high confidence produces falsely definitive claims where it should abstain or ask for clarification.
replacements.\"La imagen no tiene suficiente resoluci: "The image does not have enough resolution to identify the make with certainty. The vehicle appears to be a midsize sedan, but I cannot be more specific."
replacements.incertidumbre expresada · respuesta ajus: uncertainty expressed · answer matched to the evidence
replacements.Un modelo que siempre genera una respues: A model that always generates a high-confidence answer, even for ambiguous images or questions that cannot be answered from the available content, is not calibrated. In production, that becomes falsely definitive answers where the system should abstain or surface the uncertainty to the user.
